text: The PROLED MacBook Pro’s logo is lit with boring white LEDs. Missed opportunity.
Microsoft 365 is starting to recover as its outage enters a second day.
What a week today has been!
Nvidia is looking for a new CEO, and President Trump says the former Apple CEO would be ‘a great candidate.’
Xbox CEO Asha Sharma revealed a new entry in the Wolfenstein series with a brief tease.
Whoop’s new Humans platform is like Instagram Stories with updates from your friends’ fitness tracker data.
A new look for the Humble Bundle storefront is missing an important security feature that was previously there.
Xbox Insiders get to test the new features today.
Google’s Robby Stein says Gemini 4 Hydrogen is ‘the biggest model upgrade to Search yet.’
Many prominent voices in technology and the president of the US have publicly supported the former Nvidia CEO despite his ouster.
Oura’s last-gen smart ring sports the same sensors and software as the latest version.
Microsoft’s adding achievements to original Xbox games for the first time, too.
For some, the answer to a dodgy gray market is to bring the pharmaceutical supply chain back to American soil.
Scientists are getting tired of amateurs parachuting into their fields and making ‘discoveries’ with AI.
Microsoft 365 issues are cutting people off from their email right now.
A children’s treasury of things Alex Karp has said in public over the last three years.
A second affair has hit the news cycle, but that’s not what matters here.
Xbox has always been about trying something new, so what does Microsoft do next?
A study testing Gemini, Perplexity, and ChatGPT found that in as many as 15 percent of conversations, chatbots displayed ‘risky’ URLs.
The GDC Festival of Gaming’s latest annual industry survey shows an increase in AI usage among game developers.
